title: Pull-Up
summary: A bodyweight pull-up with an overhand grip, the main lift for the lats.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for lats (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly lats total.
Library rating 0.6 for biceps (helper): each working set adds 0.6 of a set to the weekly biceps total.
Library rating 0.5 for upper back (helper): each working set adds 0.5 of a set to the weekly upper back total.
Library rating 0.3 for rear delts (minor): each working set adds 0.3 of a set to the weekly rear delts total.
Library rating 0.3 for forearms (minor): each working set adds 0.3 of a set to the weekly forearms total.

setup.text: Hang from the bar with your hands a little wider than your shoulders and your palms facing away.
Pull your shoulders down, then drive your elbows toward your hips.
Pull until your chin clears the bar.
Lower all the way to a full hang.

form_cues.cue: Drive the elbows toward your ribs
Get your chin over the bar
Use the full range. The dead hang at the bottom is the stretch that builds the lats.

mistakes.text: Kipping or swinging to finish reps.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds two or three ramp-up sets at rising loads before the first working set, unless that load is very light.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 5% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 6-10 reps, stopping about 3 reps short of failure (RIR 3). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train comfortably.

alternatives.goal_label: Home gym: no equipment / bar only
